characters.description: The founder of Haven, a hunter and alchemist, and Villy's Chosen.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron and the head of the Order where Jake trains. He protects Jake's place in the Order and guides his development through the legacy of the Malefic Viper.
characters.name: Villy

characters.description: Haven's capable leader and Jake's principal political adviser.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: A unique lifeform also known as the King of the Forest and a representative of monsters.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: Leader of the Risen and an experienced dungeon engineer.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: A Holy Church leader and diviner.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: Haven's leading inventor and a technologist with a void-related legacy.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: Jake's hawk companion and a gifted wind user.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: A body-forging warrior allied with Jake.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: An established leader among Earth's factions.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: A Noboru Clan alchemist and swordswoman trained by her great-grandfather.
characters.name: Reika

characters.description: An Order liaison who accompanies Jake into the Indigo Caverns and helps the party search for ingredients.
characters.name: Irin

characters.description: A beastfolk alchemist with a corpse-dismantling ability who joins the Indigo Caverns expedition despite her reluctance and lack of combat experience.
characters.name: Bastilla

characters.description: A dragonkin blessed by the Malefic Viper who joins Jake's dungeon party as a powerful close-range fighter. He possesses Sense of the Malefic Viper.
characters.name: Malefic Dragonkin

characters.description: Jake's contract-bound household steward. She studies at his Order residence and is cautiously beginning to form friendships despite little experience with ordinary social life.
characters.name: Elf Steward

characters.description: An Order student who visits Jake's residence as an apparent friend of his elf steward.
characters.name: Nella

characters.description: A version of Jake created by an earlier simulation and retained within his soul space. His advice helps Jake solve the final Indigo Caverns craft.
characters.name: Sim Jake

characters.description: An Order hallmaster who agrees to contain the report that could expose Jake's identity as Villy's Chosen.
characters.name: Viridia

characters.description: An Altmar elf who has helped teach Jake's household steward and wants to meet Jake.
characters.name: Altmar Elf Associate

characters.description: The S-grade head of the Order's Humanoid Resources Department who offers Irin a place as her disciple.
characters.name: Velvet Mistress

characters.description: The Sword Saint and protector of the Noboru Clan. He is attacked after refusing the invaders' demand that he join their campaign.
characters.name: Miyamoto

characters.description: Leader of the United Cities Alliance. He launches a coordinated takeover of Earth while presenting his campaign as an effort to shield humanity from control by gods and their factions.
characters.name: Arthur

characters.description: A disciple shaped by the guidance of an unidentified primordial who supports the invading forces.
characters.name: William

characters.description: An off-world Chosen who leads the attack on Haven.
characters.name: Rival Chosen

characters.description: The unidentified primordial behind the rival Chosen and William, whose agents support the invasion of Earth.
characters.name: Rival Primordial

characters.description: An ash-and-flame unique lifeform that challenges the Fallen King in his territory.
characters.name: Ash-and-Flame Unique Lifeform

characters.description: A teleportation-circle specialist who helps Miranda prepare Haven's evacuation after Jake warns her to flee.
characters.name: Neil

characters.description: A powerful sandworm who agrees to guide and carry Jake through a distant desert in exchange for valuable earth-affinity items.
characters.name: Sandworm Guide

characters.description: An entity bound within Casper's pendant whose released soul power enables him to survive an ambush and escape.
characters.name: Lyra

characters.description: A Risen leader who joins Casper in deciding that their faction must withdraw from Earth.
characters.name: Priscilla

characters.description: The sandworm traveling with Jake. He gives her the name Sandy after they hunt C-grade scorpions and recover fragments of a space-attuned meteorite.
characters.name: Sandy

characters.description: A humanoid C-grade snake who arrives while Miranda's refugees are surrounded at the Grand Mangrove River. Her loyalties and intentions are initially unknown.
characters.name: Alabaster Crimson-Eye Snake

characters.description: A long-standing collaborator of Miyamoto who uses illusion and hypnosis to impersonate his corpse, helping him preserve the appearance of his death.
characters.name: Former Monarch of Blood

characters.description: A late-tier C-grade beast that represents aquatic creatures seeking protection under Jake's future rule and enters a tentative cooperative relationship with him.
characters.name: Sky Whale

characters.description: An unnamed old master shown in a legacy vision as Villy's respected alchemy teacher. Jake notices that the master and Villy share the same bloodline signature.
characters.name: Old Master

characters.description: Villy's deceased alchemy master, identified as a brilliant pre-System scholar with perfect memory who taught Villy alchemy and principles of the System.
characters.name: First Sage

characters.description: The ash-and-space unique lifeform fighting the Fallen King. Its domain-like soul shape allows rapid movement and escape.
characters.name: Ashen Phantom Devourer

aliases: Lord Protector of the Order of the Malefic Viper
characters.description: A god who grants Sandy a true blessing and makes the cosmic worm its Chosen.
characters.name: Boundless Hydra

characters.description: He and his children are safe in their cavern. He is nearing C-grade and popular with dungeon visitors.
characters.name: Rick

characters.description: The alabaster crimson-eye snake who protected Miranda's refugees and sheltered them at the Grand Mangrove River settlement. She chooses the full name Scarlet Allyson when Jake visits her home.
characters.name: Scarlet Allyson

characters.description: Sylphie's father, who has returned to Haven with Misty.
characters.name: Hawkey

characters.description: Sylphie's mother, who has returned to Haven with Hawkey.
characters.name: Misty
